measurement.inputs: one synthetic exact-length input per geometry; identical repeated batch rows

measurement.memory_scope: whole common Python harness process tree including parameter feeder; startup/loading, cached executable deserialization, warmup and inference; cold compilation excluded
measurement.memory_method: smaps_rollup PSS plus NVML; 0.2-second polling; median of three process peaks; footprint is peak simultaneous PSS+NVML
measurement.cpu_reference: short singleton per profile only; separate PJRT preflight also retained locally
measurement.numerical_gates: maximum raw-output error plus exact classification decisions or canonical extraction candidate indices and masks
measurement.scope: prepared host input tensors through synchronized F32 requested-head outputs; forward temporary allocations included; tokenization, final decoding, HTTP, load, backend-handle setup and post-readback cleanup excluded
